positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a design document with high level view of how frontend assets are uploaded and served in the User experience
- Set up Unit Testing framework within the new Polaris Console Package
- Migrated current framework for Appstream Console to new Polaris framework for AWS
- Created Unit tests for both Stacks and Usage Reports Page
- Migrated Usage Reports page to React from AngularJS
- Resolved 4 User tickets and issues
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Git · JavaScript

positions.title: Amazon Future Engineer Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Increased unit test coverage by 25% in function, branch, line, and statement coverage
-Implemented scheduled scaling policy(allows user to scale fleet instances during a specified time period) using AngularJS
-Designed user interface for creating, updating, and deleting a scheduled scaling policy using HTML and CSS
-Collaborated with Product Manager and team to determine best user experience

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
-Interviewed 20 users, gathered requirements from 6 team members, and synthesized information into a brief to develop a new alumni website for the school
-Created sitemap and wireframes for site. Created a tree testing survey in Optimal Workshop and analyzed user results to optimize information architecture 
-Designed 10 different layouts for alumni website using Figma. Gathered feedback from users and approval from leadership on final design
-Developed structure for website in Wix, creating templates for future content to be added
